title: Emerald Gem | KEY.co
description_expanded: Emerald Gem truly lives up to its name, offering an idyllic retreat just minutes from the breathtaking beaches of the Emerald Coast. This charming coastal townhome, with pool access, promises everything you need for the perfect seaside escape. Step inside and be embraced by the inviting coastal cottage ambiance, featuring an open floor plan and beachy decor throughout. Unwind after a sun-soaked day on the plush sectional sofa in the living room, or prepare a delightful meal in the modern kitchen, equipped with stainless steel appliances and a convenient island with barstool seating. The deck, complete with a seating area and grill, is perfect for enjoying the ocean breeze with your morning coffee or hosting a lively evening BBQ. The three cozy bedrooms provide a restful haven for your stay. The primary bedroom and second bedroom each feature a comfortable queen bed, while the third bedroom is perfect for kids with a twin-over-full bunk bed. Emerald Gem offers the best of both relaxation and adventure. Spend your days lounging by the community pool in a shady cabana or soaking up the sun in the pool. For those craving sandy shores and ocean waves, public beach access is a mere three-minute ride away. Whether you're seeking tranquil relaxation or seaside fun, Emerald Gem is your perfect getaway.
